output.title: Checking Soil Moisture in Small Containers
output.text: Overwatering is a common challenge for those keeping herb pots on a balcony. Before you reach for your watering can, perform a simple finger test to assess the moisture level of your soil. Gently push your index finger into the potting mix up to the second knuckle. If the soil feels damp or cool, your herbs likely have enough water for the day. If the soil is dry and crumbly, it is time to water. This tactile approach helps you avoid waterlogged roots and ensures your container plants receive only the hydration they need.
